To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have discovered a new high-pressure polymorph, cor-ZITO, of the transparent conducting oxides In(2-1x)ZnSnO(3), that cor-ZITO is isostructural to ZnSnO(2), and that cor-ZITO has a polar LiNb(3)O(8)-type arrangement of the cation sublattice.
we have synthesized a new polymorph of In(2-1.5x)Zn(0.5x)Sn(0.5)O(3), which is isostructural with corundum.
we synthesized a high-pressure polymorh of bixbyite-type In(2-x)Zn(x)(Sn(x))O(3) that is a solid solution of corundum and ilmenite.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a corundum-type transparent conducting oxide solid solution, cor-ZITO.
the synthesis and characterization of cor-ZITO, a new high-pressure polymorph with a corundum structure.
the development of high-pressure synthesis and characterization of new materials, with particular emphasis on transparent conducting oxides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cor-ZITO solid solution adopts a polar corundum-type structure with a high-pressure ZnSn(O) arrangement.
the cor-ZITO solid solution is a new high-pressure polymorph with a corundum-type structure.
the cor-ZITO solid solution is a high-pressure form of bixbyite-ZITO that is stabilized by the presence of Zn and Sn in a polar arrangement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cor-ZITO is the first example of a polar corundum-type material.
the corundum-type phase can be stabilized at high pressure and that it is a polar structure.
the corundum and bixbyite structures can be considered as high- and low-pressure polymorphs, respectively, of the ZnSnO(4) and ZnSnO(2) compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cor-ZITO phase can be stabilized under high pressure and that the local structure is similar to that of the high-pressure polymorph ZnSnO(2.5).
high-pressure synthesis is a useful tool for the discovery of new materials with novel properties.
